title: Implement capture session lifecycle and source reconnection
description:
Create the CaptureSession class that owns the ring buffer, PipeWire capture stream, and metrics publisher, and manages the full capture lifecycle including source disconnection detection and reconnection.

Before editing, inspect:
- src/audio/AudioRingBuffer.hpp for the ring buffer interface (write, read, overflow/underrun reporting).
- src/audio/PipeWireCaptureStream.hpp for stream lifecycle (start, stop, status callback, negotiated format accessors).
- src/audio/CaptureMetrics.hpp for the metrics snapshot publisher interface.

Do not infer APIs, schemas, behavior, or file contents; inspect the referenced files first.

Implement CaptureSession with:
- Ownership of one AudioRingBuffer, one PipeWireCaptureStream, and one CaptureMetrics instance.
- Session states: Idle, Connecting, Capturing, Reconnecting, Stopped, Error. Expose the current state and state transitions via an enum and a callback or observer.
- begin(sourceId, format, rate, channels): creates and starts the capture stream with the given parameters. Wires the stream's status callback to detect disconnection.
- stop(): cleanly stops the stream, flushes remaining ring buffer data to a consumer callback, transitions to Stopped.
- Source-loss handling: when the PipeWire stream reports disconnection or error, transition to Reconnecting. Re-resolve the source via the SourceCatalog from Phase B using the stable source identity (display name, media class, or device descriptor), not just the original numeric PipeWire node ID, since a reappeared application stream may have a different node ID. Attempt reconnection up to a configurable retry count with backoff. If resolution and reconnection fail after all retries, transition to Error.
- Expose the negotiated format metadata from the underlying stream so callers can determine native vs converted capture.
- Expose a CaptureMetricsSnapshot reader that delegates to the owned CaptureMetrics.
- Do not perform file I/O, compression, or GUI work. The session is the coordination layer between the realtime capture components; a separate writer layer (phase D or later) consumes from the ring buffer.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Visualization contract: expose a CaptureVisualizationSnapshot reader that delegates to PipeWireCaptureStream. This is the sole non-recording waveform source: callers receive a value copy and poll/deliver it from a non-realtime coordination path; CaptureSession must never drain AudioRingBuffer for visualization.
acceptance_criteria: src/audio/CaptureSession.hpp exists and declares CaptureSession with begin(), stop(), state accessors, and reconnection logic
CaptureSession owns or references AudioRingBuffer, PipeWireCaptureStream, and CaptureMetrics (verified by #include of their headers)
Session state enum includes at minimum: Idle, Connecting, Capturing, Reconnecting, Stopped, Error
Source-loss triggers a transition to Reconnecting with bounded retry attempts
Negotiated format metadata is exposed via public accessors delegating to PipeWireCaptureStream
No file I/O, compression, or Qt GUI headers appear in either file
g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only src/audio/CaptureSession.cpp -I src $(pkg-config --cflags libpipewire-0.3) passes or cmake --build build compiles the unit
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
CaptureSession exposes a bounded CaptureVisualizationSnapshot reader delegating to PipeWireCaptureStream and never drains AudioRingBuffer for visualization
